citations.reason: supabase/tests/phase_02_slice_12_gaps_api5_pattern_compat.sql:101-104 (TAP ok 167) - SEAM GUARDRAIL, publish phase of the raw-copy control.

seamRuling.technique: a DRAFT pattern row copied directly in the RPC context (g2p_raw_copy: insert ... select jsonb_populate_record(to_jsonb(draft) || {id, pattern_id, pattern_key, supersedes_id null, version 1, lifecycle_version 1, synthetic content_hash} || {compatible_type_ids: patched})), then taken through the REAL CMS-03C-06 submit, -08 assign, -07 decide, -09 activate and really placed through CMS-03C-02. Precedent: phase_02_slice_12_gaps_pattern_governed AC-200 (2b).
seamRuling.verdict: ACCEPT as a labelled state fixture; KEEP the four outcome rows and the four controls; DROP the four frozen-status rows.

points.a_substitutes_only_the_state_under_test: YES. No production function, table, trigger or grant is replaced, so nothing is renamed or restored (the whole file runs in begin ... rollback). The inserted row is a DRAFT, which the lineage guard requires for any insert (20261014020200_cms_pattern_lineage_guard.sql:23, state must be draft and updated_at = created_at), so no trigger is bypassed; activation, approval and the review chain are the real producers (the setup lines ok 112/113 and the premises assert the copy is "active through the real submit, assign, decide and activate chain"). The copy differs from its honest source in the patched compatible_type_ids and in fields the raw-copy control proves harmless (a synthetic content_hash and a fresh lineage); the submit gate checks only that nested versions are active ("by construction, compatible and acyclic", 20261013300820_cms_submit_governed_review_binding_fix.sql:154), so the state is reachable only by this route, which is exactly why the README called the branch "not runtime-proven".
points.b_every_other_disjunct_shown_false: YES. cms_pattern_live_pin_reason returns the first of: root not active (:26-28), nested missing or not active (:30-37), type containment at every edge (:41-72), digest or hash changed (:74-79). Root active: setup ok 112. Nested missing or inactive: premise ok 116 (the child is still active) and ok 117 (same owner, so it is found by the owner-scoped join). Digest and hash: the raw-copy control (rows 10-11) and the honest control (rows 8-9) pass through the same code with the same copy path; the digest branch also comes AFTER the type branch, so a digest fault could not produce this reason. Only the type set differs between the raw-copy control and the failing rows (premises ok 114/115 show the sets).
points.c_production_object_restored_and_asserte: NOT APPLICABLE. There is no substituted production object. The rolled-back transaction is the restoration of the fixture rows.
points.d_asserted_behaviour_equals_the_clauses: YES. The clause (BE03c 1585, DEC-199): a pinned nested version that is incompatible fails the pattern category with nested_pattern_not_active. The rows assert the provider's exact outcome, reason and single-offender count in both phases for the direct edge and the second-level edge. Direction and depth are pinned by mutation reasoning: reversing the containment (child subset of parent) passes {t1,t2} over {t1} and fails the direct row; testing only the root's direct children fails the recursive row; removing the block fails both.

seamRuling.ownerHalf: The "same-owner" half of BE03c 1585's "same-owner/all-parent-compatible-types graph rule" is not separately exercised: a nested version of another owner is simply not joined (child.owner_id = p_owner_id), so it surfaces through the missing-nested branch (:30-37) with the same reason. No cited test shows a different-owner pin failing as opposed to a non-existent one. The AC text of c3 ("the existing graph compatibility rule") is AC-211's "listing every compatibleTypeIds member of the new pattern", which is the type half; I accept the clause as closed by it and record the owner half as a gap.

missedGaps: Owner half of the DEC-199 rule not shown (see seamRuling.ownerHalf): constructible, if wanted, with the same technique by copying the parent draft with a block_tree that pins a pattern of the other organisation and showing the reason.
The case-insensitive UUID comparison in the containment test (:67, lower(listed.value) = lower(required_type.value)) and the depth<9 bound (:52) are not exercised; neither is named by the clause.

Placement is linked mode on type-1 entries; a plain detached NULL-tree row keeps live checks (c6) and is covered by PC-N04/N06 for the active branch, not for the compatibility branch. Not required by c3.
